fieldValues.title: Reader of a finished work
fieldValues.summary: A person who receives a finished piece of work and reads it. They did not make it, are not editing it, and care about the final product more than how it was built.
jobs: Open what they were sent and read it
Check what the work rests on
Go deeper when something raises a question
fieldValues.needs: The finished work as a finished work, with its sources within reach and no setup required before reading.
